1778-4247-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Memnite is starting in your graveyard.
1778-4247-5006-8170.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Memnite, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

545-2390-3966.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
545-2390-3966.description:
Gain life.
Bloodbond Vampire triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

3899-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
3899-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4591-6732-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
4591-6732-8089.description:
Activate Souldrinker by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

2292-4640-7082--201.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1978-4694-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.

1778-1927-3558-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-1927-3558-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

549-3197-6824-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-3197-6824-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 6 or greater

215-539-7308-7781.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Mona Lisa
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3490-4050-5070-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-5070-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

413-719-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-719-4302.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

703-3455-7149.description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Vizier of Many Faces into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Vizier of Many Faces dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Vizier of Many Faces enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Vizier of Many Facess into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Vizier of Many Faces tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-3455-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

2034-6887-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2034-6887-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3259-4742-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-4742-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5315-6972-7160.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-5205-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2105-4359-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
2105-4359-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2510-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1636-5147-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
1636-5147-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
Repeat.

1491-4549-6702.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Kilo, adding {1}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Kilo.
Activate Kilo by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1445-2366-4772-4826-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2366-4772-4826-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3933-4929-5479-6260.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3933-4929-5479-6260.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

2060-2713-4565-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-4565-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

64-957-1987-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
64-957-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

1477-4321-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1477-4321-5777.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

3967-4231-4321-5270-5682.description:
Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Astrid, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

2239-2665-3617.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Ardent Elementalist.
2239-2665-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
When the token Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1612-5342.description:
Cast Shard of the Nightbringer by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}.
When Shard of the Nightbringer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz and you to gain that much life.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

983-1637-1987-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Islands.
983-1637-1987-4423.description:
Activate Temple of the False God and Mystic Sanctuary by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Temple of the False God and Mystic Sanctuary.
When Temple of the False God and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, Aesi triggers twice and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve both Aesi triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

539-1003-2653-4300.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, Nissa triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Phyrexian Walker to your hand from the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token with flying.
Repeat.

732-2792-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{R}.
732-2792-4222.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Great Whale with haste.
The token Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.

292-2259-3356.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Polyraptor.
292-2259-3356.description:
Deal damage to Polyraptor.
Rite of Passage and Polyraptor trigger.
Resolve the Rite of Passage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Polyraptor.
Resolve the Polyraptor trigger, creating a token copy of it.
The Polyraptor token enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Empire's second ability, dealing 1 damage to each creature.
Rite of Passage triggers for each creature you control, and each Polyraptor you control triggers.
Resolve all Rite of Passage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve a Polyraptor trigger, creating a token copy of it.
Repeat from step 5.

3270-4050-5220.manaNeeded: {4}{U/B}{U/B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3270-4050-5220.description:
Cast Gyruda by paying {4}{U/B}{U/B} and commander tax, if applicable.
Gyruda enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gyruda, adding one mana of any color.
Gyruda dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Gyruda on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Gyruda ability from step 2, causing each player to mill four cards and you to return Gyruda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

170-2034-5189.notablePrerequisites: Ghave has at least one +1/+1 counters on it.
170-2034-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ghave, creating a 1/1 Saproling token.
When Saproling token enters the battlefield, Woodland Champion triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Saproling token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Woodland Champion, creating a 1/1 Saproling token.
Repeat from step 2.

539-1247-2597.notablePrerequisites:
Wild Growth attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-1247-2597.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
